description: A dotnet new template that scaffolds a multi-tenant microservices topology using Trellis: YARP gateway minting internal-network JWTs + two opinionated downstream services (Projects + Members) demonstrating tenant isolation, RBAC/ABAC, resource-based authorization, and the HideExistence pattern for HR-sensitive data. Includes Aspire AppHost, OpenTelemetry-instrumented ServiceDefaults, click-to-send .http scenarios, and the same code-style + analyzer gates as the upstream Trellis.Microservices packages.
title: Trellis Microservices Templates
